summary: Completed frontend-only MediConnect smoke and responsive testing. Home navigation, all 10 Patiala hospitals, filtering, hospital expansion, safety labeling, Maps links, doctor search, local console workflows, demo auth messaging, mobile navigation, and mobile console tabs passed. Production build also passed.
action_items: Make status-pill data-testid values unique when multiple unavailable/capacity pills render, or scope them to their owning hospital/doctor row, to satisfy the unique test-ID requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: StatusPill emits repeated data-testid values such as status-pill-full and status-pill-unknown across many rendered rows/cards; this weakens deterministic UI automation and violates the requirement that user-facing states have unique data-testid attributes.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing local/demo directory data only; no live medical availability was represented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend flows covered at desktop 1920px and mobile 390px. Recheck status-pill test IDs after scoping/uniquifying them. Firebase and Google Maps JavaScript credentials remain intentionally unconfigured; Firebase is local preview and directions are Google Maps search URLs.
rca of the issue: Repeated state IDs originate in StatusPill, which derives data-testid only from the status string. Rendering the same state in multiple hospital cards and doctor rows creates duplicate DOM IDs. No functional workflow failure was found.
